authority: User direction in the Worldwright project conversation
name: The inverted startup
purpose: Make the capability freely available, help people become independent, and sustain the work through paid human services and voluntary fair contributions.

paidServices.description: In-person training and guided practice; the teaching material remains free

contributions.principle: Contribute what you believe is reasonable and fair, according to your means

userIndependence.encourage: Learn to bring and manage your own agent
userIndependence.successfulHandover: The person has their installation, source, agent and understanding to continue
userIndependence.initialCorpus: The first example of a reusable pattern, not required subject matter for every world

costResponsibility.principle: Help users understand and minimize their costs while preserving useful outcomes
costResponsibility.futureManagedUsage: Explicit costs, limits and funding; no unlimited subsidy promised
benchmarkBasis: total cost including retries and corrections

currentScope: Operating model documented; no billing, booking or managed-service implementation. Experiential curvature is separately authorised in context/project.json.
agentConstraints: Preserve free access under the applicable licenses
Keep voluntary contributions separate from payment for agreed human work
Do not infer subscriptions, paywalls, compulsory tithing or managed-service dependency
Do not implement billing, public signup, automatic subdomains, managed API/hosting or other features without a subsequent request
